login.sub: Sign in to manage your store.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Sales, open orders and quote requests show here once your first product is live.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Products you add appear here with price, MOQ and review status.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyBody: Retail and company orders for your products land here. Ship them and add tracking from each order.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.emptyBody: When a company buyer requests a quote, set unit prices, lead time and validity here, then send the offer.

messages.title: Messages
messages.emptyBody: Buyer questions about your products and quotes appear here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyBody: Sales, top products and buyer reports build up as orders come in.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.emptyBody: Each delivered order adds a payout line: order total minus commission and refunds.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.emptyBody: Store profile, staff, shipping options and KYC documents are managed here.

signup.sub: Apply to sell on iCommerce. We review every company before its products go live.

errors.passwordShort: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
errors.country: Pick the country your company is registered in.
errors.phone: Use digits with country code, e.g. +20 100 123 4567.
errors.badLogin: Email or password is wrong. Check both, or reset your password.
errors.noStore: This email has no store yet. Apply to sell with the same email and password.
errors.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account with a different password. Sign in instead, or use another email.
errors.alreadyVendor: This email already has a store. Sign in instead.
errors.nameTaken: A store with this name already exists. Add your city or legal suffix, e.g. "Acme Plastics Cairo".
errors.imageType: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
errors.imageSize: Images can be up to 5 MB each. Export a smaller file and try again.
errors.imagesMax: Upload up to 10 images at a time.
errors.crNo: Commercial Registration No. is digits only (up to 12), as printed on your registry extract.
errors.exportCard: Export Card No. is 3–20 letters, digits, / or -, as printed on the card.
errors.kycFilesRequired: Attach at least one document: commercial registry extract, tax card or export card.
errors.kycFilesMax: Attach up to 10 files. Combine pages into one PDF if needed.
errors.kycFileType: Use PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP files.
errors.kycFileSize: Each file can be up to 10 MB. Scan at a lower resolution and try again.
errors.titleRequired: Enter a product title buyers will search for, e.g. "Aluminum stock pot, 40 L".
errors.handleTaken: Another product already uses this title's web address. Make the title more specific, e.g. add size or model.
errors.price: Enter the price in USD as a number, e.g. 12.50.
errors.compareAt: Compare-at price must be higher than the price, or leave it empty.
errors.costPrice: Enter cost as a number of 0 or more, or leave it empty.
errors.positiveInt: Use a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.
errors.maxBelowMin: Maximum quantity must be at least the minimum order quantity.
errors.csvSize: CSV files can be up to 5 MB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.url: Use a full link starting with https://
errors.reasonRequired: Tell the buyer why you're canceling.
errors.optionNameRequired: Give the option a name buyers understand.
errors.freeOver: Enter the cart amount in USD above 0.

kycNeeded.title: Verify your company to start selling
kycNeeded.body: Your store is pending approval. Add your Tax ID, Commercial Registration and Export Card with scans. You can add products now; they go live once your store is approved.

kycReview.title: Documents under review
kycReview.body: iCommerce is checking your company documents. Products you add stay in "Awaiting approval" until your store is approved.

kycRejected.title: Documents need changes
kycRejected.body: We could not verify your company with the documents sent. Fix what the note below asks for and submit again.

suspended.title: Store suspended
suspended.body: Your store is hidden from buyers. Edits you make wait for review. Contact iCommerce support to restore selling.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.sub: How your store appears to buyers on iCommerce.
settings.name: Company name
settings.emailHelp: Shown to buyers. Defaults to your sign-in email.
settings.descriptionHelp: What you make, since when, main markets and certifications. Plain text.
settings.logoHelp: Square PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
settings.bannerHelp: Wide image, about 1600 × 400 px, up to 5 MB.

kyc.title: Company verification (KYC)
kyc.sub: Buyers see a verified badge once iCommerce checks these documents. Numbers must match the scans.
kyc.linkSub: Tax ID, Commercial Registration, Export Card and scans.
kyc.taxIdHelp: 9 digits from your tax card, e.g. 512-483-907.
kyc.filesHelp: Registry extract, tax card and export card. PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 files, 10 MB each.
kyc.replaceNote: Submitting again replaces these files and restarts the review.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Add your first product, or import many at once from a CSV file. Each product shows price, MOQ and review status here.
products.noMatchBody: Try another search term or status.
products.caption: Your products, {count} in total
products.pageOf: Page {page} of {pages} · {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}

product.title: Title
product.descriptionHelp: Material, sizes, finish, packing. Buyers compare these.
product.hsCodeHelp: Customs tariff code, e.g. 7615.10. Shown to export buyers.
product.compareAtHelp: Optional original price, shown struck through.
product.unitHelp: What one quantity means: piece, set, m2, kg, ton.
product.minQtyHelp: Smallest quantity a buyer can order.
product.qtyStepHelp: Buyers order in multiples of this, e.g. 50.
product.imagesHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB each. The first image is the cover.
product.retailHelp: Single items with add to cart. Unchecked: companies only.
product.b2bOnlyHelp: Companies request a quote; no add to cart.
product.publishHelp: Live on the storefront and in search.
product.pendingHelp: Your store is awaiting approval. The product shows as "Awaiting approval" and goes live once iCommerce approves it.

import.title: Import products from CSV
import.sub: One row per product. Good rows are created even when other rows have errors.
import.fileHelp: UTF-8, header row first, up to 1,000 rows and 5 MB.
import.pendingHelp: Your store is awaiting approval, so products can't go live yet.
import.summary: {created, plural, =0 {No products created} one {# product created} other {# products created}} · {failed, plural, =0 {no rows with errors} one {# row with errors} other {# rows with errors}}
import.columnsSub: Copy this header row into the first line of your file. Order doesn't matter; extra columns are ignored.

col.title: Product title.
col.handle: Web address, lowercase-with-dashes. Default: from title.
col.compare_at_usd: Original price in USD, shown struck through.
col.b2b_only: true or false. true = wholesale only.
col.image_urls: Image links separated by |. First is the cover.

rowErrors.title: Add a title in the title column.
rowErrors.price: price_usd must be a number of 0 or more, e.g. 12.50.
rowErrors.compareAt: compare_at_usd must be a number of 0 or more, or empty.
rowErrors.positiveInt: {value} must be a whole number of 1 or more, or empty.
rowErrors.b2bOnly: b2b_only must be true or false.
rowErrors.handleFormat: handle must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. steel-pipe-4in.
rowErrors.category: Category "{value}" doesn't exist. Use an existing category handle or leave it empty.
rowErrors.handleTaken: Handle "{value}" is already used. Pick another handle.

orders.title: Orders
orders.sub: Retail orders for your products. Ship pending orders and add tracking so buyers can follow them.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Order number, buyer name, email, city or phone
orders.emptyBody: When a buyer checks out with your products, the order lands here. Ship it, add tracking, then mark it delivered.
orders.noMatchBody: Try another search term or status.
orders.caption: Your orders, {count} in total

paymentHelp.cod: Your courier collects cash from the buyer. Marking the order delivered records the payment.
paymentHelp.bank: The buyer pays iCommerce by bank transfer. You can ship once we confirm the money arrived.

orders.awaitingTransfer: Waiting for the buyer's bank transfer. You can ship as soon as iCommerce confirms the payment.
orders.trackingUrlHelp: Optional. The buyer gets this link in the shipping email.
orders.deliverHelp: Mark delivered once the buyer has the goods. The buyer gets an email.
orders.deliverHelpCod: Mark delivered once the buyer has the goods and paid your courier. This records the cash payment and emails the buyer.
orders.cancelHelp: Only before shipping. The buyer is not charged for canceled items.
orders.cancelReasonHelp: For example: out of stock, can't deliver to this address.
orders.returnNoteHelp: Optional. E.g. where to send the items back.
orders.refundManual: iCommerce refunds the buyer once the items are back.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.sub: Delivery options buyers can pick at checkout for your products. Prices in USD, delivery within Egypt.
shipping.linkSub: Delivery options and prices buyers see at checkout
shipping.emptyBody: Buyers can't check out your products until you add at least one option. Start with a flat rate.
shipping.caption: Your delivery options

kindHelp.free_over: Flat price, free once the cart reaches the amount.

shipping.name: Name buyers see
shipping.freeOverHelp: Counted on the buyer's whole cart.
